title: Watch list
description: Pages scripts/check_watchlist.py re-reads for new awards and programs. The committed list (data/catalog/watchlist.json) holds only pages that say nothing about the student; family pages go in data/private/watchlist.json, same shape.

id.description: Stable slug; part of every proposal id this entry writes.

page.description: single: the page is one award or program. listing: the page links to one page per award; new links are followed.

months.description: Months (1-12) the page is worth checking.

terms_note.description: The day a person read the site's terms and robots.txt, and what they allow. Null: the entry does not run.
